title: Mathematics Practice Test 2 - Mathematics - Functions and Tables
subject: Mathematics

questions.q:
Some values of the function $g$ are given in the table. One of the following equations defines $g$. Which one?

| $x$ | -2 | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $g(x)$ | 0 | -8 | -6 | 0 | 10 |
questions.explain: Test the coordinate points from the table in the given options. Using $(0, -8)$: Options a, b, and d all yield $g(0) = -8$, while c gives 2. Next, use $(2, 0)$ on the remaining candidates. For a: $g(2) = -2(2) - 8 = -12 \neq 0$. For b: $g(2) = -2 - 8 = -10 \neq 0$. For d: $g(2) = 2(2)^2 - 8 = 2(4) - 8 = 8 - 8 = 0$. Verifying another point $(3, 10)$ in d gives $2(3)^2 - 8 = 18 - 8 = 10$, which works.
